fullContentHtml:
GIMS Noida Staff Nurse Online Form 2026 – Extended – Full Details

Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS), Noida has released a notification for the recruitment of Staf Nurse Posts on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 100 posts. The online application process for GIMS Noida Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 has started from 10 August 2026, and candidates can apply until 30 October 2026 (Extended). Candidates are advised to check the complete details for GIMS Noida Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 August 2026
  • Last Date : 30 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1298/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 944/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 00/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Official Notification
  • Official Website

GIMS Noida Staff Nurse Online Form 2026 – Extended is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
